world.title: Midterm disaster sparks MAGA rebellion as Trump loyalists question his role in Republican losses
world.summary: Following significant Republican losses in the midterm elections, Trump loyalists are questioning the future of the MAGA movement. Supporters, initially hopeful for a victory by Senate candidate Ken Paxton, expressed disappointment as they left a Dallas event. The Democrats' success has prompted discussions among Trump’s base about the movement's viability and its implications for the Republican Party moving forward.

world.title: Europeans will join Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French foreign minister says
world.summary: European nations will join discussions on Ukraine in Abu Dhabi next week, as announced by French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot on Sunday. He emphasized that European representation will be strong, with France actively participating in the talks. The meeting aims to address ongoing issues related to the conflict in Ukraine and foster diplomatic dialogue among involved parties.

world.title: Harsh Goenka questions how Indian tourists behave abroad after viral Vietnam video
world.summary: A viral video showing Indian tourists sitting on the floor and eating at a Vietnam airport has ignited discussions about civic sense and public etiquette. Businessman Harsh Goenka shared the video, questioning the behavior of Indian tourists abroad. The incident highlights concerns regarding appropriate conduct in public spaces, as airport floors are typically designated for walking and waiting.

business.title: Indian economy to grow faster, foreign capital returning to markets: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan
business.summary: India is projected to experience accelerated economic growth, maintaining its status as the fastest-growing large economy globally, according to NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan. This growth is attributed to robust macroeconomic fundamentals, increasing domestic savings, and a resurgence of foreign capital in the markets. The outlook suggests positive trends for investment and overall economic performance in the upcoming year.

business.title: Investing Rs 50,000 In Gold This Diwali? Compare Jewellery, Coins And Digital Gold Before Buying
business.summary: As Diwali approaches, many Indian households consider investing in gold. Buyers can choose between jewellery, coins, and digital gold. Coins offer an alternative to jewellery, avoiding high making charges and providing flexibility in weight options. This year, families are encouraged to compare these options before spending, as gold remains a popular choice for hedging against inflation and financial uncertainty.

business.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
business.summary: The Indian stock market declined during Muhurat Trading on November 8, ending a six-session winning streak. The Sensex and Nifty fell, with Nifty dropping below 25,000 as investors took profits. Despite this, broader market sentiment remained positive, with 2,716 stocks on the NSE advancing compared to 736 that declined, indicating ongoing investor interest in the market.

technology.title: Rockstar's GTA 6 Physical Edition Reportedly Leaked; Here's What We Know
technology.summary: An alleged image of the physical packaging for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) has emerged online, featuring protagonists Jason and Lucia. This leak has generated excitement among gaming fans, although the authenticity of the photograph is still unverified. The game is scheduled for release on November 19, 2026, heightening anticipation within the gaming community.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S27 series tipped to get a major redesign: Price, display and more
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy S27 series is anticipated to undergo significant redesigns, featuring a new Pro model, a revamped camera island, and built-in magnets for wireless charging. Enhancements may include brighter displays, upgraded processors, and improved camera capabilities. Expected pricing and additional details about the flagship lineup are also anticipated as the release date approaches.

technology.title: Sony revives iconic 1979 Walkman design with MDR-3R USB-C headphones: Check price in India
technology.summary: Sony has reintroduced its iconic 1979 Walkman design with the launch of MDR-3R USB-C headphones. The vintage theme extends to the product's packaging and instruction manual, replicating the original unboxing experience. The headphones aim to appeal to nostalgia while incorporating modern technology. Pricing details for the product in India have not been specified in the announcement.

sports.title: GT, DC discuss Ashutosh Sharma trade
sports.summary: Gujarat Titans (GT) and Delhi Capitals (DC) are discussing a potential trade involving Ashutosh Sharma, a player currently with DC. GT seeks a proven finisher and has previously offered a fast bowler for a trade. Meanwhile, Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) are also looking to strengthen their batting, having a surplus of pacers available for trade.

health.title: Tamil Nadu's TB care initiative records at least 38% reduction in deaths
health.summary: A study by the ICMR National Institute of Epidemiology and Tamil Nadu State TB Cell reports a 38% reduction in tuberculosis-related deaths in Tamil Nadu. This decline is attributed to the Tamil Nadu Kasanoi Erappila Thittam (TNKET), a targeted initiative designed to eliminate TB deaths in the state. The program aims to improve TB care and outcomes.

health.title: Tamil Nadu's TB care initiative records at least 38% reduction in deaths
health.summary: Tamil Nadu's TNKET program has achieved a minimum 38% reduction in tuberculosis (TB) deaths from July 2024 to December 2025. This initiative focuses on early triage and prioritizing hospital care for severely ill patients. The program aims to improve outcomes for TB patients across various cohorts, significantly impacting the state's overall TB mortality rates.

health.title: Tamil Nadu's TB care initiative records at least 38% reduction in deaths
health.summary: Tamil Nadu has achieved a 38% reduction in tuberculosis (TB) death rates from July 2024 to December 2025 through a statewide initiative. This program focuses on identifying severely ill patients at diagnosis and prioritizing them for hospitalisation. The initiative aims to improve TB care and outcomes, contributing to the overall reduction in mortality associated with the disease.

science.title: Want to fly to moon? NASA is looking for new astronauts to help grow its Artemis programme
science.summary: NASA is accepting applications for a new astronaut class to support its Artemis programme, which aims to establish a permanent lunar base. The announcement was made during an air show at Kennedy Space Center. Interested candidates can apply to participate in missions that will contribute to lunar exploration and development, enhancing the future of human spaceflight.

science.title: Future astronauts wanted: NASA opens recruitment for moon missions
science.summary: NASA has announced the recruitment of a new astronaut class aimed at supporting future moon missions. The agency seeks individuals who will contribute to establishing humanity's first permanent lunar base. This initiative marks a significant step in advancing space exploration and expanding human presence on the Moon. Interested candidates can apply as part of this historic opportunity.

science.title: Hawking, the celebrity theoretical physicist
science.summary: On November 8, 2018, Stephen Hawking's early wheelchair sold for nearly £300,000, while his doctoral thesis fetched almost £585,000. Hawking, a renowned theoretical physicist, became a celebrated figure despite his physical challenges. His contributions to science and popular culture have left a lasting impact, making him an iconic symbol of intellect and perseverance in the scientific community.

entertainment.title: Priyanka Chopra's Diwali Album Is All About Family Time With Nick Jonas And Daughter Malti
entertainment.summary: Priyanka Chopra Jonas shared her Diwali celebrations on social media, showcasing family moments with husband Nick Jonas and daughter Malti Marie. She wore a maroon and gold outfit adorned with intricate embellishments. The series of pictures highlighted the family's festive spirit and traditional attire, offering fans a glimpse into their celebrations during the holiday.

entertainment.title: BTS V's Recent Actions Directly Linked To Dating Rumors With BLACKPINK's Jennie
entertainment.summary: BTS V's recent actions have fueled speculation regarding dating rumors with BLACKPINK's Jennie. Discussions intensified after both were reportedly spotted at the same restaurant in Los Angeles, leading to increased public interest in their relationship status. The ongoing discourse surrounding their potential romance continues to attract attention from fans and media alike, contributing to the buzz surrounding both artists.

entertainment.title: Daler Mehndi BREAKS SILENCE on Uttarakhand live performance controversy with a Diwali message, thanks brother Mika Singh and wife Taran: 'Brother Mika stood up for me like a force to reckon with'
entertainment.summary: Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi addressed the Uttarakhand live performance controversy in a Diwali message, expressing gratitude to those who supported him during challenging times. He specifically thanked his brother Mika Singh and wife Taran, stating that his family has been his greatest strength. Mehndi's note reflects his appreciation for their solidarity and encouragement throughout the ordeal.
